action: Use the PLAN.md and D-09 values (requirements.md REQ-AIR-01, -02, -05). The market study's owner may update its table.
who_confirms: PM
close_condition: Decided (D-09); the CO2 and noise check on the prototype is recorded.

issue: 'One hand tool' and 'every part 20 kg or less' need exact meanings. PROPOSED: tool-free connectors wherever they hold the joint; otherwise captive M6 bolts, and one driver bit or key fits all of them (handling aids like suction lifters, a spirit level or a knife don't count). A part is each piece handled on its own during delivery and assembly. The glass or acrylic front is the stated exception and gets a 2-person handling method.
evidence: PLAN.md Targets 1 and 2; Lead's rulings 2026-10-31.
action: Use these meanings in requirements.md REQ-ASM-03 and REQ-LGT-02.
who_confirms: PM
close_condition: The product owner confirms.

issue: 'Every part fits through a 914 x 2032 doorway' needs a check rule, and stairs, corridor turns and lifts aren't covered. PLAN.md on main also says pieces fit 'an 81 cm door and a normal elevator', which is narrower than 914. PROPOSED rule: sort a part's 3 sizes a <= b <= c; it passes if a <= 810 and b <= 2032, using the narrower 81 cm door (carried straight through, no allowance for hands or wrapping).
evidence: PLAN.md Target 2.
action: Apply the rule in the layout study and list the delivery-path assumptions.
who_confirms: PM
close_condition: Rule confirmed.

issue: The fans blow through the roof, so the room needs clear space above the pod. No minimum gap or other site need (power point, floor flatness, sprinklers) is stated.
evidence: Build plan rule 7; PLAN.md notes on US rules.
action: Set a minimum gap above the roof from the air design; write an install requirements sheet.
who_confirms: PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Install requirements with numbers.

issue: With the thin floor (PROPOSED) the walls stand on the room floor, so wall panels grow about 100 mm taller than v1's 2300 mm: they run from the floor to the roof, with the base band as trim. The panel split, part weights and pallet heights all change.
evidence: v1 STEP walls Z(v1) 102...2402; conventions.md section 4; PLAN.md pallet sizes (side frames about 1150 tall).
action: The layout study uses the new panel heights.
who_confirms: PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Split option with real panel heights.

issue: Decided (D-11): reserve hooks for a later voice cockpit kit built on the in-house Lamp electronics (mic array, speakers, computer), plus a screen and a status light. Hooks are 12 V 5 A power, data, mounts and a cable path. The kit itself is not designed. PLAN.md still lists 'room mic and agent status light' as left out of v2; the hooks don't add them.
evidence: Lead's message in the Swarm chat, 2026-10-31; PLAN.md 'Left out of v2'.
action: Requirements REQ-VCK-01...06; assembly tree interfaces IF-15 and IF-16; ELECTRICAL reserves a fused 12 V 5 A outlet, a data link and a cable route.
who_confirms: PM
close_condition: Hooks and reserved power shown on the ELECTRICAL and WALL drawings.

issue: The roof should later take a sprinkler head or open on alarm (US rules, later), but nothing says how: space, opening, a wire to a fire-alarm signal.
evidence: PLAN.md 'Later, not in the v2 prototype'.
action: Reserve a zone in the ceiling and a wiring point; no design yet.
who_confirms: PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Reserved zone shown on the ceiling drawing.

issue: A thin floor of about 20 mm leaves a 20 mm step at the door. US accessibility rules (later) allow about 13 mm at a threshold, bevelled; more needs a ramp.
evidence: open-questions.md Q4; 2010 ADA Standards 404.2.5 and 303 (unverified: from memory, not checked against the text).
action: Decided (D-18): a 20 mm threshold. Draw it bevelled; note the thinner door zone a US version would need.
who_confirms: PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Threshold detail drawn; US path noted.

issue: 'Flat, level floor' has no number, and leveling has to cope with real office floors. PROPOSED working value (assumption): the pod handles +/-5 mm over its footprint with the base seal and packers; worse floors need a leveling kit.
evidence: PLAN.md 'Same look, lighter bones'.
action: Confirm the floor tolerance to design for; check it against a floor-flatness standard (for example DIN 18202) before release.
who_confirms: PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews; PM
close_condition: Tolerance confirmed and the leveling method tried on the prototype.

issue: The v1 files don't show which way the door swings (the hinges sit evenly either side of the glass). The hinge side is decided (D-19, left); the swing direction is still PROPOSED: outward.
evidence: v1 STEP 'Shower Hinges' Y(v1) -724...-674 around the glass at -704...-694.
action: Confirm with the v1 owner; keep outward in v2 unless told otherwise (open-questions.md Q3).
who_confirms: PM (decision log); indoor pod lead engineer gives input
close_condition: Swing direction confirmed.

issue: The v1 CAD models the 300 mm handle on the outside face only. There's no inside pull.
evidence: v1 STEP 'Handle' Y(v1) -744...-704 (outside the glass face at -704).
action: The v2 handle set has an inside grip (open-questions.md Q1).
who_confirms: PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Handle set selected.

issue: Some items don't fit a 48 x 40 pallet: the glass door (2011 tall), the fixed glass (about 2017 tall; 2139 in the v1 BOM), the side decor blocks (about 2300) and the ceiling halves (about 1240 wide, 20 mm over 1219). They need a standard long pallet or a split.
evidence: PLAN.md 'Design for the pallet'; v1 STEP boxes.
action: Decided (D-04): 48 x 40 pallets plus one standard long pallet, decor not split. The layout study fits the ceiling halves (20 mm over 1219) and lays out each pallet.
who_confirms: PM; PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Pallet layout chosen.

issue: The 'vít sắt' (steel screws) that fix the plywood (plan VT02) to the 20x20 frame (plan VT10) are undefined: type (self-drilling?), size, spacing, and how they hold in a thin tube wall. Factory joint.
evidence: Build plan rule 5 ('VT02 được bắn cố định vào khung VT10 bằng vít sắt').
action: None: D-17 removes the plywood, so these screws are gone. The ACP-to-frame joint is ISS-016.
who_confirms: PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Joint register entry with SKU and pitch.

issue: The decor skin is ACP 'cut with grooves and folded' to the faceted shape, but the process is undefined: groove profile, skin left at the fold, fold angles, corner backing, and which ACP core allows it. The faceted shapes must match v1's decor.
evidence: Build plan section VI ('VT01 sẽ được cắt rãnh và bẻ góc'); v1 decor-frame-assembly p13-p16 (panels 'Ghép mí 45°').
action: Write the ACP routing and folding spec with the maker's data; rebuild the decor facets from the v1 STEP.
who_confirms: PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Forming spec and flat patterns checked against the v1 facets.

issue: Spaceship reuses two in-house modules: the Desk Pro AI sensor hub (CO2, presence, air quality, sound level) and the Lamp electronics (mic array, speakers, computer). Their supply voltage and current, size, mounting, data link and placement rules aren't in the repo, and there's no public data.
evidence: Product owner's update passed on by the Lead, 2026-10-31; requirements.md REQ-ELE-02.
action: Collect the internal datasheets or drawings of both modules; add them to the hardware selection, the load table and the placement rule (REQ-ELE-04).
who_confirms: PM (provides the data); PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Module data on file, with source and date; load table and placements updated.

issue: Plan VT07 pairs a one-way switch with the socket, but nothing says what the switch controls. With mains going only to the outlets (REQ-ELE-01) and the lights on 12 V, a mains switch for the lights no longer fits.
evidence: Build plan VT07 and rule 8; requirements.md REQ-ELE-01.
action: Decide the light control: a 12 V switch, or the sensor hub with presence. Keep the plan's socket as the mains outlet.
who_confirms: PM (decision log); indoor pod lead engineer gives input; PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Light control decided and drawn on the wiring diagram.

issue: The 12 V DC bus (REQ-ELE-01) needs a design: the supply's rating (at least 150 W by the first budget, REQ-ELE-03), fuses for each branch, wire sizes for voltage drop over the run to the roof, where the supply sits and how its heat leaves, and plug connectors at the panel joints.
evidence: requirements.md REQ-ELE-01, REQ-ELE-03, calculation C8.
action: Draw the DC distribution with the load table, fusing and wire sizes; place the supply in the back wall band.
who_confirms: PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Wiring diagram and load table checked; connectors chosen with SKU.

issue: Decided (D-02): 300 kg stays the goal, the build lands at about 380 kg as the best value with a 400 kg hard cap, and about 22-23 dB speech reduction (ISO 23351-1 Class C), calculated, with the factory sample deciding. It replaces PLAN.md's '300 kg or less' and 'at least as quiet as v1, aim 30 dB' (300 kg stays the goal where quiet allows). PLAN.md was synced on main (ba0aefe): about 385 kg and about 24 dB. The final stack calculates at 24.2 dB (range 21.7-26.7) and about 385 kg.
evidence: Lead's messages of 2026-10-31; PLAN.md Targets 1 and 5 and the 'Better by' scorecard.
action: Work to the ruling (requirements.md REQ-LGT-01, REQ-SND-01, REQ-SND-03).
who_confirms: PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Factory sample and lab results recorded; PLAN.md updated by its owner.

issue: Decided (D-08): tool-free connectors, captive bolts, factory-made subassemblies and pre-fitted felt. This changes build plan rule 5 (felt stuck on with hook-and-loop after assembly): the felt now arrives on each panel, so its edges at panel joints must be detailed so the joints still seal and can still be bolted.
evidence: Lead's message of 2026-10-31; build plan rule 5.
action: Requirements REQ-ASM-03, REQ-ASM-05, REQ-ASM-10, REQ-ASM-11; joint register entries show the connector or captive bolt per joint.
who_confirms: PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Joint register shows the connector or captive bolt for every site joint, and the panel drawings show the felt at the joints.

issue: v1 is marketed at about 30 dB speech reduction, but the calculation gives v1 about 15 dB as built. Nobody has tested v1 in a lab to ISO 23351-1.
evidence: v2/research/market-study.md (FocusPod v1 row: about 30 dB, 'preliminary'); the calculation reported by the Lead on 2026-10-31 from the sound and air check (v2/05-Engineering/acoustics-air/, not yet in main).
action: Test v1 in a lab to ISO 23351-1, in the same lab as v2. Until then, don't quote 30 dB for v1 or use it as a v2 baseline.
who_confirms: PM
close_condition: Lab result for v1 on file, and the product page claim reviewed against it.

issue: Decision D-13 lets STEP files stay in cm when the file declares it (drawings and DXF stay in mm). AGENTS.md still says 'Use mm everywhere', and the guideline (3.1) asks for mm with a unit check after every import or export.
evidence: decision-log.md D-13; AGENTS.md 'Rules that matter most'; guideline 3.1.

evidence: Hardware Engineer's report (commit ae219f6), part weights.

issue: D-07's fallback front, 4+4 acoustic laminated glass, gives 24.6 dB but brings the pod to about 416 kg, over D-02's 400 kg cap, unless the ceiling drops to a 40 mm stack (23.8 dB at 400 kg).
evidence: Hardware Engineer's report (commit ae219f6), section on the decided build.
action: If the acrylic sample fails, the PM decides between the thinner ceiling and a cap exception.
who_confirms: PM

area: ELECTRICAL, LINING (cables in the cassette gap)
issue: The 25 mm gap inside each lining cassette is both the acoustic gap and the spare cable path (voice cockpit, lights). A cable or box fixed to both the cassette and the frame would bridge the floating cassette and leak sound.
evidence: Hardware Engineer's report (commit ae219f6), cable path and sound notes; requirements.md REQ-VCK-03.
action: Clip cables to the cassette only, with slack and soft grommets where they cross to the frame or a panel joint; show it on the wiring drawing.
who_confirms: PM (decision log); hardware engineering lead reviews
close_condition: Routing rule on the wiring drawing and in the joint register.
